svg.title: 18 labs, one learning journey
svg.desc: 18 labs, one learning journey | Find the skill you need before choosing a model. | GEOAI FIELD GUIDE / Original teaching schematic — not observed health data | ORIENT | 00 / 01 / 04 / 06 / 07 | Maps, spatial scale, rainfall, runtime and catalogs | LEARN PATTERNS | 02 / 03 / 05 / 08 / 09 / 10 / 11 | Clusters, anomalies, text similarity and graph roles | TEST ASSUMPTIONS | 12 / 13 / 14 / 15 | Bounded plans, change, terrain and route scenarios | INTERPRET + DECIDE | 16 / 17 | Report-derived statistics, evidence and perspectives | Transfer the method to health only after adding suitable data, governance and validation.
svg.text: Find the skill you need before choosing a model.
